desk-grant is retired: since Claude Code 2.1.321 the Asana and Slack panes' own calls run without a permission prompt, so they no longer need a helper plugin. Requires Claude Code 2.1.321 or later.

- desk-asana and desk-slack no longer depend on desk-grant. Their pane calls run as the plugin's own MCP calls, which Claude Code 2.1.321 makes without a permission prompt or the auto-mode check; deny rules still apply, and a call to a denied tool fails
- On Claude Code 2.1.320 or earlier the pane calls are permission-checked again: a prompt on every press in default mode, refused in auto mode, and the timed Slack new-message check fails silently. Update Claude Code before updating these plugins
- desk-grant is gone from the marketplace, so an installed copy fails to load (`Plugin desk-grant not found in marketplace`). Remove it with `/plugin uninstall desk-grant@cc-desktop-mod`
- The panes no longer show the "update desk-grant" warning, and desk-slack no longer stops checking for new messages because of it
- `/desk-update` no longer updates desk-grant
- desk-look, desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.76.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
